notes: Chunk 100: 6 pages, one Common Crawl snapshot each; all six readable. sourceUrl is the Common Crawl index lookup printed in each file footer; sourceDate is the capture timestamp date. Lausanne (PhD in Management, 2021-09-20): the page has no placement list, only a prose list of example institutions (no names) and seven testimonials from former doctoral students with their then-current affiliations; recorded those seven with listedYear null. Affiliations are current positions at snapshot time, not stated first placements. Mannheim GESS alumni (2019-02-20): whole-school list in three sections (Business = CDSB, Economics = CDSE, Social Sciences = CDSS); the year in parentheses is not explained on the page (yearMeaning unstated; probably graduation year but not stated). Position/destination were split from the single placement string by a title heuristic (first comma or " at "); seven entries were deliberately kept whole in destination with position null (Juliane Wutzler, Maximilian Germann, Michael Potstada, Christian Felix Michel, Claudia Liebscher, Anke Söllner, Felix Dinger). Entries with no placement line have destination null. Two trailing name-only duplicates at the end of the Economics section (Chia-Yu Tsai, Ekaterina Kazakova, without years) were not added as separate rows. Degree not stated per person; GESS is a doctoral school. Only the Business section is likely relevant to operations/management placements; most of the list is economics and social sciences. UNSW (2021-09-19): undated "most recent placement highlights" across all Business School PhD areas; the school in parentheses is recorded as program; degree PhD because the page describes them as PhD students. Oxford Saïd DPhil in Management (2020-09-20): two job-market candidates (no year; yearMeaning job-market) and eight placements under "Doctoral students, 2019" and "2018" (yearMeaning placement; whether the year is the placement year or completion year is not stated). "Placement institutions" list has no names and was not recorded. Xuan Wang's stated interests are finance topics although listed on the DPhil in Management page. Padua (2020-09-27): four job-market candidates on the Management-students page (no year, no destination); page email addresses omitted as personal contact details. Wharton LGST PhD Alumni (2020-09-30): eleven names with years in parentheses, no placements; the department is Legal Studies & Business Ethics, not operations.
